9. Main Purpose of Position:
The main purpose of the position is to oversee the administration, budgetary goals, and adherence to the goals of
the grant within the project. The Program Coordinator is charged with overseeing the graduate students,
scheduling and overseeing the lab and experiments, providing administrative and budgetary support to the PI, and
generally completing tasks per the award guidelines as needed. Knowledge of the subject matter and engagement
with the grant's goals are necessary.

10. Duties & Responsibilities:
Plan, organize, and coordinate the program
Monitor the progress of activities and determine if there is any unanticipated activity that must be addressed
Schedule staff to ensure delivery of services and activities
Develop resources for program implementation
Analyze data to prepare reports and evaluation forms on progress, achievements and problems during the project
Handle interviews, surveys, and supervision of graduate students with regards to the overall outcome of the
program or project
Determine specific needs in terms of equipment, supplies, or personnel for different sections throughout the
program or project
Maintain and manage data and budgetary records
